name: retry-vs-retry-gate
title: 重试撞重试串行化闸门 —— 一个既不该进槽、又该被守卫看见的表（票 5an）
description: 补 execution-plane §7.1 留给下一任务的唯一输入：同一进程内 ripple-retry / publish-retry 互相看不见，两次重试可同时在飞。实现一个不扩宽通用 busy 谓词的重试声明表 + 原子领取，覆盖两种重试的入口守卫；补抓测试、文档与 claim 值。
creator: codex
notes: IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-31. Closes the single open input of execution-plane §7.1: two repairs could be in flight together because the guards read only the slot (ripple-retry deliberately stays out of it) and the lease grants a second holder of the same process. Shape chosen: a third table, `_runner._retry_tasks` (thread_id -> task | None), with claim-before-create_task (synchronous, so two concurrent requests cannot both start; the loser never creates a task), attach_retry binding the task + done callback (a `finally` would not run for a task cancelled before its first turn), abandon_claim for the create_task-raised path, and identity-guarded cleanup. Both entry guards now ask `process_has_active_task(...) or retry_in_flight(...)`; nothing OR-s the new table into the two general busy answers (claim `busy_answerers_reading_the_retry_gate = 0`). Not closed, deliberately: cross-process retry-vs-retry stays the lease's job; the execution-vs-retry direction is unchanged; pre-claim validation writes (publish-retry force) may be repeated by the loser (same value, idempotent). Tests: tests/unit/api/test_retry_vs_retry_gate.py 13 passed (both directions, concurrent rendezvous without clock samples, cancel-before-first-turn, abandon, identity guard, static non-widening assertions); execution-plane claim table + anchors + citation corpus green; claim test gained 6 values (2 write sites / 1 predicate / 2 handler readers / 2 claim sites / 0 busy answerers / done-callback cleanup). Docs: §7.1 input list now empty and records the ruling; §6 corrected 34 -> 38 rows (4 previously unlisted task-spawn sites) and line refs remapped; agent-os + memory-promotion drift fixed in the same round (separate commit). ruff check + ruff format --check green.
